'''Night-vision goggles''', also called '''night goggles''' and '''nightsight goggles'''<ref name="TAS">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=The Argovia Strike}}</ref> were a type of [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] that granted the wearer improved vision during the night and in low visibility conditions. The night goggles enhanced the view by tenfold and brightened everything the user saw in an eerie [[Color/Legends|green]] glow. They also distorted all colors the user saw to varying shades of green. When not in use by the user, they were usually clipped to the users [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]]. A sudden flash of brightness was known to overload night goggles and temporarily blind the user.

They were often worn by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the field. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] once used a pair during his [[Mission to Hallion|mission]] on [[Hallion]].

==Behind the scenes==
Night goggles first appeared withing [[Michael Allen Horne|Michael Horne's]] adventure ''[[For a Few Kilotons More]]'', which was published as part of the book [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']] in [[1993]].
